productFit.name: DWARFLAB Mini Tripod with Hydraulic Head
productFit.metricSpecs: DWARFLAB: folds to 25 cm, 360° pan, +90°/-75° tilt, head 300 g; the English post keeps 775 g, 53 cm and 3,0 kg from DWARFLAB's US page, keep those.
productFit.reason: DWARFLAB runs EU country stores (e.g. the Slovak store) with the same Mini Tripod page; a German Astrotreff owner ordered it directly from DWARFLAB.

productFit.name: K&F Concept 64-Inch Aluminum Travel Tripod (O234A1+BH-36)
productFit.metricSpecs: Sold as 163 cm / 8 kg (same as the English post).
productFit.reason: idealo.de lists the K&F Concept O234A1+BH-36 from EU shops under the same model code.

productFit.name: Manfrotto Befree Advanced Lever Tripod Kit
productFit.variant: In the EU the lever aluminium kit is sold as MKBFRLA4BK-BH (US code MKBFRLA4BK-BHUS); same legs and 494 ball head.
productFit.metricSpecs: 1,59 kg with head, 128 cm column down, 151 cm column up, 40 cm folded, 9 kg (Manfrotto); same as the English post.

productFit.name: Manfrotto 290 Xtra Aluminum Tripod Kit with 3-Way Head (MK290XTA3-3WUS)
productFit.variant: Outside the US Manfrotto sells the same kit as MK290XTA3-3W (no 'US' suffix): 290 Xtra legs with the 804 3-way head.
productFit.metricSpecs: Use the English post's B&H metric figures: 171,5 cm max., 136,9 cm column down, 41,9 cm min., 70,6 cm folded, 2,54 kg, 10 kg.
productFit.reason: Manfrotto lists the kit as MK290XTA3-3W on its non-US store pages; the product images are named mk290xta3-3w.

productFit.name: Sky-Watcher Star Adventurer Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: Astroshop gives 69,5-121,5 cm and 1,8 kg (retailer, not maker); keep the English figures 63,5-113,7 cm and 2,35 kg so numbers match the English post.
productFit.reason: Astroshop (DE, also .es/.nl) sells the Sky-Watcher tripod for AZ-5/AZ-GTi/Star Adventurer under the same name.

localFacts.fact: KLM: hand baggage including handles and wheels max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm; by folded length the DWARFLAB Mini Tripod (25 cm), the K&F Concept (39,5 cm) and the Befree Advanced (40 cm) fit, the 290 Xtra (70,6 cm) does not.
The Netherlands spans from about 50°45' N (southernmost point, Zuid-Limburg) to 53°32' N (Rottumerplaat), so the EQ-mode tilt to latitude is roughly 51 to 53,5 degrees (about 52° in Amsterdam).
Nationaal Park Lauwersmeer has been a Dark Sky Park since October 2016; at night access is the same as by day (roads and paths), with recommended spots such as Lauwersnest and the hemelplatforms.
Dutch terms: statief, middenzuil, balhoofd, 3-weg-kop / pan-tiltkop, hydraulische kop, snelkoppelplaat, 1/4"-schroefdraad, draaisluiting, klemsluiting, poolhoogte / breedtegraad.

localPainPoints.pain: Wind on the open Dutch coast and polders sets even sturdy tripods vibrating, which stretches stars in 60 s EQ subs.
localPainPoints.fix: Column down, thin sections in, weight under the tripod; a 3-section tripod (290 Xtra) on exposed spots.
